name: audio.levels
title: Levels by time window
summary: RMS, sample peak and ungated LUFS per time window of an audio or video file, using explicit windows, a fixed step, or a musical bar/beat grid.
description: Analysis only. Windows come from an explicit list, a step in seconds or a bar/beat grid. String times (scene ids, cues, bar:n, beat:n) resolve against a timeline JSON using the same grammar as timeline.layout. Silence is reported as null, never -Infinity.

input.description: Audio or video file to measure: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

timeline.description: Optional timeline JSON (timeline.layout output) used to resolve string times such as scene ids, cues, bar:n and beat:n.

windows.description: Explicit windows. Each is measured over [from, to).

name.description: Optional label copied into the result row.

from.description: Window start: seconds or a timespec (scene id, cue, bar:n, beat:n).

to.description: Window end: seconds or a timespec (scene id, cue, bar:n, beat:n).

step_s.description: Window length in seconds: [0,s), [s,2s), ... The last window is cut at the duration.

grid.description: Musical windows starting at offset_s, one per bar (default) or beat.

offset_s.description: Seconds before the first window starts.

per.description: Window length: one bar or one beat.

rows.description: One row per window, in order.

name.description: Window label, when one was given.

rms_db.description: RMS over all channels in dBFS, or null for silence.

peak_db.description: Sample peak over all channels in dBFS, or null for silence.

lufs.description: Ungated K-weighted loudness of the window in LUFS, or null for silence.

examples.title: One-second windows of a 3 s tone
